items.quote: If you need a new app, use Dev Dashboard to create one with a proper OAuth flow.
items.why: Mentions OAuth flow only; no bearer_token or api_key methods.

items.quote: For a new app, declare the scopes it needs and deploy your app. Merchants approve the scopes when they install it.
items.why: Covers OAuth scope approval at install; silent on bearer_token and api_key.

items.quote: Shopify grants access scopes only to public or custom apps.
items.why: Scope access limited to public/custom apps; no explicit admin approval gate stated.

items.quote: The REST Admin API is a legacy API as of October 1, 2024. Starting April 1, 2025, all new public apps must be built exclusively with the GraphQL Admin API.
items.why: States REST Admin API legacy since Oct 1, 2024; GraphQL is the required path.

items.quote: Some newer platform features may only be available in GraphQL.
items.why: Says some features may be GraphQL-only; claim says 'are', and hedge differs.

items.quote: The server runs locally and doesn't require authentication.
items.why: Implies a local server exists, no auth needed; says nothing on vendor-official or the URL.
